initial:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent RGBA magazine prop for a cozy hand-painted 2D game.
Input 1 is the EXISTING magazine cover to preserve. Input 2 is a reference for the isometric surface angle ONLY; do not draw the raft.
Transform the magazine into a CLOSED physical magazine lying FLAT on the same plane as the wooden raft, viewed from above at a three-quarter isometric angle. Preserve the pink border, cream blank title strip, sunny tropical two-cats-and-palm-tree cover illustration, brown outline and watercolor shading of input 1. Do not invent readable words or logos.
CRITICAL geometry: the magazine's LONG edge must run from LOWER LEFT toward UPPER RIGHT, parallel to the long raft logs in input 2. In normalized square canvas coordinates, the TOP COVER quadrilateral should have corners approximately (0.10,0.57), (0.42,0.77), (0.90,0.45), (0.58,0.25). The cover top/title edge is the far upper-right edge between (0.58,0.25) and (0.90,0.45). This is a flat object on an isometric deck, NOT an upright book, not a front-facing cover tilted in 2D.
Show a pink bound spine, a clearly visible slim cream paper stack beneath the cover at the near/lower edges (about 4% of canvas height), tiny page-layer lines and slightly rounded cover corners. Strong enough warm side shading and a small tight soft contact shadow directly under the magazine to show volume; no huge shadow. Keep all edges crisp at small game size. ONE isolated magazine only, genuine transparent background and generous margins; NO raft, wood, hands, pelican, cats outside the printed cover, sea, extra objects, text labels or borders. Highest available square resolution.
orientation:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix ONLY the physical orientation of this magazine. It must lie flat, but rotate the magazine 90 DEGREES ON THE HORIZONTAL GROUND PLANE while keeping the camera fixed, so its LONG spine now runs from the LOWER LEFT toward the UPPER RIGHT, parallel to the long logs of reference 2. Do NOT simply rotate the whole image in 2D.
The long pink spine should connect approximately (15%,60%) near-left to (63%,25%) far-right of the square canvas. The far short/top edge and cream title banner should run from approximately (63%,25%) to (90%,45%). The near short/bottom edge with visible cream pages should run from (15%,60%) to (43%,80%). Thus the cover is the parallelogram [(15,60),(43,80),(90,45),(63,25)] in percent coordinates. The title banner is on the FAR UPPER-RIGHT EDGE, the cats' feet and bottom cover are toward the NEAR LOWER-LEFT edge. Preserve the exact pink cover, two cats, palm tree, watercolor style, book thickness, page edge detail and warm shadow. Transparent background, ONE magazine only. No raft, no extra objects, no labels or letters. Keep generous transparent margin.
